metadata.description: Personal skills for product specification writing, implementation planning, DevOps pipeline planning, task ticket generation, constitution writing, GitHub ticket implementation, and GitHub PR review

plugins.name: product-spec
plugins.description: Write and maintain product specification documents in docs/specs/

plugins.name: impl-plan
plugins.description: Create and maintain implementation plan documents in docs/plans/

plugins.name: devops-plan
plugins.description: Generate DevOps pipeline plans as markdown documents in .github/workflows/

plugins.name: task-tickets
plugins.description: Generate and register task tickets from implementation plans to a kanban tool (GitHub Projects, Linear, Notion, Jira)

plugins.name: constitution
plugins.description: Write and maintain project constitutions — coding standards, documentation policies, and team conventions in docs/constitutions/

plugins.name: implement-ticket
plugins.description: Implement a GitHub project ticket with per-sub-item commits, live status tracking, and automatic PR creation

plugins.name: review-pr
plugins.description: Review a GitHub PR using the official code-review skill and post findings as inline review comments with one-click code suggestions
